snippet.title: METRO Redux - Next Gen Update Launch (4K)
snippet.description:
The METRO Redux Next Gen Update is live now, bringing a huge number of visual and performance upgrades to METRO 2033 & METRO Last Light! Plus it is FREE for all existing owners of METRO 2033 Redux and METRO Last Light Redux.

Console players can now experience true 4K at 60FPS or upscaled 4K at 120FPS, with native support for PlayStation® 5, PlayStation® 5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S™. Meanwhile, PC players can look forward to playing both games at 4K resolution with uncapped frame rates, alongside DLSS and Spatial Audio support.

These visual and performance improvements are accompanied by a host of community bug fixes and title-specific tweaks. You'll find the full update notes here: https://deepsilver.com/games/metro2039/news/metro-redux-next-gen-update-everything-that-s-changed

Pre-order METRO 2039  at www.METRO2039.com

Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pbrmwfc4k8r
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/product/EP8459-PPSA18995_00-METRO039DELUXEWW
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590240/METRO_2039/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/metro-2039-deluxe-edition-ed4042

Exclusive Rewards for Deep Silver Account Members
As well as enhancing the modern METRO universe for the latest gaming hardware, the Redux update also brings Deep Silver Account support to both METRO 2033 and METRO Last Light.

First added to METRO Exodus at Gamescom, you can now link your Deep Silver Account to one or more of these three titles to unlock an exclusive comic book! Simply follow the in-game QR code and then sign in to your Deep Silver Account to receive your reward.

For each of the three games you link, you'll also receive a competition entry to win a copy of METRO 2039, launching on February 4th, 2027. You'll receive a further competition entry for signing up to the Deep Silver newsletter, giving you up to four chances to win. //LINK//Keep your radios tuned to the official METRO social media channels and newsletter for more updates, trailers and news. Follow us here on YouTube for the latest video content. 

#Metro2039 #4AGames #DeepSilverTwitter/X: https://x.com/metrovideogame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/metrovideogame 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MetroVideoGame/ 
Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@metrovideogame 
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@metrovideogame 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/metrovideogame.bsky.social 
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/metrovideogame About METRO Redux:  

Including the epic single-player campaigns of both METRO 2033 and METRO Last Light, METRO Redux takes you on a journey from the forgotten catacombs beneath the earth to the desolate wastelands above, where your actions will determine the fate of mankind.

• Play Artyom's epic journey in METRO Redux in this definitive version, rebuilt in 2014 and now further updated to take advantage of modern Playstation hardware while preserving the gameplay of the original experience.

•  Brave the horrors of the apocalypse, and immerse yourself in the Moscow Metro – equip your gasmask and an arsenal of hand-made weaponry as you face the threat of deadly mutants, human foes, and supernatural phenomena in one of the most atmospheric worlds in gaming 

• Two unique Play Styles : ‘Spartan’ and ‘Survival’ – approach the campaign as a slow burn Survival Horror , or tackle it with the combat skills of a Spartan Ranger in these two unique modes 

• The legendary Ranger Mode returns – dare you play the fearsome Ranger Mode? No HUD, UI, deadlier combat and limited resources combine to create the ultimate immersive experience 

Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky
